messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGER: prefills causing GPU OOMs in rg-prod-gpu pool 'ded-ephemeral-7' — ~40 container restarts in last 5m. Affected model: grp-bert-2 (long-context). Paging #oncall-eng

matt (oncall): ack, i'm on it. joining bridge now.

eva (eng-runtime): saw large token prefill spikes from a few customers — sequences > 60k tokens. streaming clients dropping mid-stream.

sre: logs show repeated CUDA OOM in prefill path, container restart loop. sample: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.20 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity)`

matt (oncall): quick customer-impact check — 3 endpoints show ~12% 5xxs for large-context routes, normal routes fine.

eva (eng-runtime): mitigation plan: 1) apply soft prefill cap (PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=32768) 2) route >32k token requests to coldmodel variant 3) scale pool +2 nodes 4) cordon noisy node(s) if restarts continue.

sre: thumbs. i'll cordon any node with >10 restarts/min after scaling.

infra-bot: executing scale: `rdictl pool scale --pool ded-ephemeral-7 --add 2 --reason "prefill-oom mitigation"`

infra-bot: scale accepted, provisioning 2 nodes (g4dn.xlarge-ish). ETA ~90s.

matt (oncall): applying runtime cap now: `rdictl config set runtime.PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=32768 --env prod --model grp-bert-2`

eva (eng-runtime): also enabling fallback routing: `rdictl route create --from grp-bert-2 --to grp-bert-2-coldmodel --condition "prefill_tokens>32768"`

sre: found noisy node node-gpu-23 with 18 restarts in last 3m. cordoning

sre: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-23 && kubectl drain node-gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

infra-bot: node-gpu-23 drained and cordoned. workloads rescheduled.

matt (oncall): after scale+cap+cordon, restart rate dropped from 40 -> 4 restarts / 5m. error rate on affected endpoints down to ~3%.

eva (eng-runtime): observed one CUDA backtrace in logs — adding to postmortem bucket. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z runtime[pid=2345]: libc++abi: terminating due to unhandled exception: CUDA out of memory
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve/prefill.cc", line 421, in prefill
    kv_cache.reserve(prefill_len)
  File "cuda/runtime.cpp", line 89, in allocate
    throw runtime_error("CUDA OOM")
```

customer-ops: notified top customers via status.redwood.ai incident update, included ETA and mitigations. one enterprise replied wanting a phone update — handed to solutions lead.

matt (oncall): temporary hotspot mitigations in place. rolling a tight canary for the cap on 10% of traffic for 15m, then 100% if stable.

eva (eng-runtime): started canary rollout. monitor groups: latency, restarts, 5xx.

sre: created a temp alert: `prefill.oom.rate > 10 / 1m -> pager` with a higher threshold so we avoid noise during recovery.

infra-bot: canary at 10% live.

matt (oncall): stream stability improving. i'll keep watch for 30m then hand off to jen for night rotation.

jen (oncall-next): taking handoff at 00:00PT. thanks, please DM if anything flares.

eva (eng-runtime): post-incident followups: - add model-level prefill guard in runtime - add long-prompt evals to perf tests - consider prefetch memory cap by shard - add clearer customer guidance re max supported context.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied (prefill cap, fallback routing, pool +2, node cordon). Status: partial mitigated. next: postmortem and follow-up RFC.

matt (oncall): closing live triage. will update status page in 10m and kick off postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
